name: uma
description: Near-DFT energies, forces and geometry relaxations with Meta FAIR's UMA ML interatomic potential (fairchem-xpu) on Aurora XPU; one row per structure. Defaults to the 'batch' inference path -- 'default'/'high-precision' give WRONG forces on XPU and are refused.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md s5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool uma.calc(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls the loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). The runner resolves the fairchem-xpu python + FAIRCHEM_CACHE_DIR worker-side from site.<system>.json; one structure per row, energy/forces (+optional LBFGS relax). timeout_each 180s covers batch first-call warmup (~2s) plus short opt; raise it for Nitro-XPU's 25-50s Triton JIT or many-step relaxations. 'omat'/'oc20'/'odac'/'omc' heads and periodic systems are UNVERIFIED on XPU (SKILL): only 'omol' was tested.
